Usage: apimark [options] [language [language-options]]

  -?, -h, --help             Display this help message
  --silent                   Suppress console output
  --validate                 Run self-validation tests
  --results, --result <file>  Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)
  --depth <#>                Set the top-level heading depth for generated Markdown output (default: 1)
  --format <value>           Output format: gradual (default) or single-file
  --log <file>               Write all output to log file

Languages:
  dotnet    Generate API documentation from a .NET assembly
  cpp       Generate API documentation from C++ headers
  vhdl      Generate API documentation from VHDL source files

dotnet options:
  --assembly <path>          Path to the .NET assembly (required)
  --xml-doc <path>           Path to the XML documentation file (required)
  --output <dir>             Output directory for Markdown files (required)
  --visibility <value>       Visibility filter: Public, PublicAndProtected, All (default: Public)
  --include-obsolete         Include obsolete members in generated output
  --exclude <pattern>        Exclude namespaces/types matching a wildcard pattern (repeatable)
  --enforce-docs <value>     Enforce XML doc <summary> coverage at a visibility tier: Public, PublicAndProtected, All (default: disabled)
  --enforce-docs-severity <v> Severity when --enforce-docs finds violations: Warning, Error (default: Warning)
